features: The Report Type now starts on Group Proponents instead of Individual Beneficiaries, and the Reset button goes back to it
Saves a step for staff who mostly report on group projects

The Group Proponents report now shows Date Released, Date of Turn-over, Date Due for Liquidation and Date Monitored right after Date Approved. The Individual Beneficiaries report shows Date of Turn-over and Date Monitored
The whole timeline of a project can be read in one row, without opening each record
Side-to-side scrolling for the report table
The table now scrolls left and right so every column can be reached. The search box and page buttons stay in place, and the column headings stay visible while scrolling down
All columns are readable on any screen size, even with the extra dates

A line saying the report was generated through the system, with the date and time, now appears under the report on screen, when printing, at the bottom of the PDF and as the last line of the Excel file. The CSV file stays plain data
Printed and downloaded reports show where and when they were produced

screenshots.caption: Figure 1. The Reports page now opens with Group Proponents already selected as the Report Type.
Figure 2. The Group Proponents report table scrolls sideways, with the search box and page buttons kept in place. The "generated through the system" line is at the bottom of the report.
Figure 3. Scrolled to the right: the new Date Released, Date of Turn-over, Date Due for Liquidation and Date Monitored columns, right after Date Approved.
Figure 4. The Individual Beneficiaries report gets Date of Turn-over and Date Monitored.
